# Security Answer Kit

> Security Answer Kit helps agencies, freelancers and small software firms (1 to 25 people) answer the vendor security questionnaires their bigger clients send. A free in-browser tool builds a one-page Security Overview and a gap list. The paid kit has 86 prefilled questionnaire answers in 16 areas, 8 security policy templates and 5 email scripts.

- Free: the Security Overview builder. Runs in the browser, no account, nothing is uploaded.
- Paid: the full kit, EUR 49 once, paid through PayPal. No subscription. 14-day refund on request.
- Not included: certification (the kit does not make you SOC 2 or ISO 27001 certified) and legal advice.
- Maker: an independent business in Germany (see the imprint).

## Product

- [Security Answer Kit, free Security Overview builder and kit](https://security.toolkitsdesk.com/): build the overview, see sample answers, buy the kit.
